name: Pipistrel Virus SW
summary: Slovenian light-sport two-seater with a glider-like airframe: slender wings, a T-tail and a pod-and-boom fuselage. Sold as a light-sport aircraft, ultralight and kit.

wings: High cantilever wing, long and slender, glider-like
Air brakes (spoilers) on the upper surface
engines: Single Rotax 912/914 in a small, pointed cowl
fuselage: Pod-and-boom composite fuselage with a smooth teardrop cabin
Fixed tricycle gear with streamlined fairings
tail: T-tail with the horizontal stabilizer on top of the fin

tellTales: Slender high-wing motorglider look with a T-tail
Slim pod-and-boom fuselage with a small pointed cowl
Long thin wing and fixed streamlined gear

confusedWith.howToTell: The SA160 has a strut-braced wing and a conventional tail; the Virus has a strut-free slender wing, a pod-and-boom fuselage and a T-tail.
The DA20 is low-wing; the Virus SW is high-wing, with a more glider-like boom tail.
The 150 is a boxy strut-braced high-wing with a conventional tail; the Virus is a smooth, strut-free glider-like high-wing with a T-tail.
